STEP 1 - Scene: A side-dish style meal on a serving tray: a bowl of mixed steamed/cooked vegetables (broccoli, carrot, corn, green beans or celery) and a bowl of chopped leafy green salad (romaine-type lettuce with what look like cubes of cheese or tofu and olives/dark pieces).

STEP 2 - Vessels: Two small white paper/compostable bowls, each roughly 15 cm diameter (cereal-bowl size) on a tray. Bowl area = 3.14 x (7.5)^2 ≈ 177 cm² each. The vegetable bowl is the left/front bowl; the salad bowl is at the back right. Both belong to this meal.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Cooked mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrot, sweetcorn, green beans/celery)
- Chopped romaine/leafy salad
- Cheese or tofu cubes and olives in the salad

STEP 4 - Area (of each 177 cm² bowl):
- Mixed vegetables: covers ~55% of its bowl ≈ 97 cm², piled to ~3 cm height.
- Salad: covers ~70% of its bowl ≈ 124 cm², piled to ~3 cm.
- Cheese/olives: ~5% of salad bowl ≈ 9 cm², ~1.5 cm.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Vegetables: 97 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 290 ml (gross)
- Salad leaves: 124 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 372 ml (gross)
- Cheese/olives: 9 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 14 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Vegetables: 290 ml x 0.6 ≈ 174 g
- Salad leaves: 372 ml x 0.15 ≈ 56 g
- Cheese/tofu cubes: 14 ml x 0.9 ≈ 13 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Mixed vegetables (cooked): 174 g x 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 70 kcal
- Leafy salad: 56 g x 18 kcal/100 g ≈ 10 kcal
- Cheese (feta-like): 13 g x 290 kcal/100 g ≈ 38 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 243 g and ≈ 118 kcal. This is plausible for two small side bowls of vegetables and salad, with no dressing visible. Sparse salad pieces and cubes are modest in weight.

Total: about 243 g, about 118 kcal.
